_about: Ambient occlusion of the six STALKER maps at a stock strength (the owner, 2026-11-14, with a place on Military Warehouses: "on fence there are black stripes", "often those happen for some reason with this engine"; with r_ambient_occlusion_quality 0 in the console: "yes, it fixes"). The stripes are the occlusion's own sample pattern on a far flat wall: screen-aligned, about 6 pixels apart; the fence there is solid and faces away from the sun, and its textures have no such lines. The ports' environments have ao_saturation 2; stock maps have 1 to 1.29 (level_03 day: 1). ao_saturation is an exponent in both of 0.26g's occlusion shaders: (1 - occluded)^(2 x ao_saturation) x 1.1 at r_ambient_occlusion_quality 1 (ssao_hemisphere_optimized.ps), (1 - occluded)^(3 x ao_saturation) x 1.2 at 2 and 3 (ssao_hemisphere_stable_radius.ps). So the pattern is drawn with the exponent 4 here where level_03 has 2: an occlusion of 0.2 leaves 0.45 of the ambient light instead of 0.70. ao_saturation 1 in the six maps' ten projects. Their ao_radius 1.5 is a stock value (level_02 day) and stays. Nothing else of the environments changes. Visual only. Vostok v0.11 (1.5) and Chemical Plant v0.11 (1.3) are above stock too and are not changed here.
